label: Sfx: Angelus's cast, shaft-hit, close and landing arms, before the shared rune-crack fallback
why: v74 §6.2's voices -- the rise's choir swell, the shaft hit's glassy tap pitched by the blessing count, the close's chord resolving down -- and the landing thud §6.2 names, which the engine did not have (it plays only its wall tick on a floor contact). Code's picks on the numbers under Rick's 'you pick i overrule': cast 3 VOWEL, tap 5 SKY, close 1 STEP, land 3 DEEP (angelus_voice_lab.py). Through the patched play() each arm reproduces its lab candidate to 1e-07; 127 other voices unchanged (worst 1e-07); ult/angelus is no longer rune-crack (0.63). Arms added BEFORE the shared rune-crack fallback; that line is re-emitted unchanged, last. Presentation only: play() returns on its first line headless.

label: tickRise: the shaft-hit tap, once per shaft hit healed, after its blessing, carrying the count
code:
T.bless += u.healPer * n;
          /* ASCENSION'S SHAFT HIT (v74 §6.2: "a bright glassy tap, 70ms,
             quiet; blessing count in the pitch"): once per shaft hit healed,
             after its blessing lands -- the NEXT live step after the blow,
             once the blow's own hit stop has run -- pitched by the count the
             caster now carries (1-5; at the cap the blessing refreshes and it
             taps at 5's note). The blow keeps its own `hit` voice. A shaft
             hit on a Twinshade shade heals too, so it taps too. Presentation
             only: SFX.play draws nothing, is a no-op headless, and nothing
             here is read back (angelus_voice_lab: fights identical). */
          SFX.play("ult", { w: "angelus-shaft", n: f.stacks("blessing") });
why: The tap, at the heal's own step, after the blessing lands: 3555 taps == 3555 shaft hits healed over 152 fights, each carrying the caster's blessing count after the heal (1..5). Fights identical 152/152 and every other voice call identical 152/152 with the rows applied; the rows plus one sim write come back identical in only 1/152.

label: tickRise: the close, when the window closes by its clock with both alive; the drop is marked
why: The close chord only when the window closes by its clock with both alive (512 closes == 512 such closes); none for the 8 death closes, the 0 clock closes on the step the foe died, or the 86 windows still open at the fight's end (stage 5's reading 10: tickRise never runs again, the death voice has that moment, the picture closes the shafts). It sets `falling` on riseTally, which the simulation never reads (the caster's riseTally differs by `falling` alone in 152/152).

label: move: the landing thud, on the first floor contact after a clock close, the caster alive
why: The thud on the first floor contact after a clock close, the caster alive: 470 thuds == 470 such landings; 42 fights end before the ball lands. Mode `after`, so the row's code is only what it adds: its anchor is the bounce's own spawnFx line, which it does not repeat.
